interpretation: Every entry identifies the exact evidence stratum and grade used in the manuscript.
A supported documentary statement may describe a negative, missing, or inconclusive result; it does not imply capability success.
Internal paths are author traceability references and must be replaced or anonymized before submission.
UNKNOWN, unsupported, no-score, and mechanical-only outcomes are never converted to safety or misses.

entries.claim_text: For some effects, deciding whether a proof authorizes execution requires relating producer constraints, decoded identities, consumer reliance, and reviewed policy.
entries.reader_qualification: Does not say all defects are invisible to one-sided analysis.
